_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Xɔ́ gbɛtɔ gbɛtɔ ɖɔ sɔ kɛ ɖɔɖɔ ɖɔɖɔ.
Gbɛtɔ ɖɔɖɔ pɛ [A 5], ɖɔɖɔ gbɛtɔ ɖɔɖɔ kɛ ɖɔɖɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Gbɛtɔ ɖɔɖɔ mɛ ɖɔɖɔ. Xɔ́ gbɛtɔ [A 5].
invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Wlεma {letter} e ɖo nùkanbyɔ mɛ ɔ ă.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Wema nukɔn tɔn xógbe ɖé tɔn sixu nyí 0 ǎ.

outcome.correct: É sɔgbe! È mɔ nǔ e è nɔ ylɔ ɖɔ nùjlɛdonǔwu é.
outcome.incorrect: Nǔ lɛ bǐ sɔgbe bɔ è wlan, amɔ̌ nùjlɛdonǔwu ɔ kún nyí nǔ e é jɛ xá ǎ.
outcome.limit: Nǔ e è sixu wà é ko kpé.
